title: Tiny, cute slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- shadow under slice -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="30" ry="7" fill="#3a1f0f"/>
    <!-- pizza crust -->
    <path d="M50 22 L82 78 Q50 90 18 78 Z" fill="#e0a458"/>
    <!-- crust edge highlight -->
    <path d="M50 22 L82 78 Q50 90 18 78 Z" fill="none" stroke="#f5cf8e" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- inner pizza body / sauce -->
    <path d="M50 34 L75 74 Q50 83 25 74 Z" fill="#d9482f"/>
    <!-- cheese layer -->
    <path d="M50 40 L71 71 Q50 79 29 71 Z" fill="#ffd84d"/>
    <!-- cheese highlight -->
    <path d="M50 46 L67 69 Q50 75 33 69 Z" fill="#ffe98a"/>
    <!-- pepperoni 1 -->
    <circle cx="43" cy="58" r="5" fill="#b22222"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="57" r="1.5" fill="#e04040"/>
    <!-- pepperoni 2 -->
    <circle cx="57" cy="62" r="5" fill="#b22222"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="61" r="1.5" fill="#e04040"/>
    <!-- pepperoni 3 -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="4" fill="#b22222"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="49" r="1.2" fill="#e04040"/>
    <!-- tiny sprinkle -->
    <circle cx="38" cy="68" r="1.5" fill="#3a8f3a"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#3a8f3a"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="67" r="1.5" fill="#3a8f3a"/>
    <!-- smiley face on pizza (cute!) -->
    <circle cx="46" cy="63" r="1.5" fill="#5a1a1a"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="63" r="1.5" fill="#5a1a1a"/>
    <path d="M46 67 Q50 71 54 67" fill="none" stroke="#5a1a1a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- little sparkle -->
    <path d="M72 30 L74 35 L79 37 L74 39 L72 44 L70 39 L65 37 L70 35 Z" fill="#fff59d"/>
  </g>
</svg>
